commits.subject: docs(spec): audit teardown safety — per-box gate on retrieve success
commits.body:
Brainstormed design for fixing the partial-retrieve-then-teardown
data-loss risk in audit_driver.py + audit_attach.py. New helper
teardown_retrieved(provider, boxes, retrieve_results) filters the
clean subset before calling teardown_all. Behavior matrix + data
flow for four cases (happy / partial / systemic failure / pre-
retrieve exception) + 9 unit tests covering the filter contract.

Key invariant: destruction requires explicit evidence of success.
Anything that doesn't produce retrieve_results[box.name] == "ok" —
exception, crash, partial, skipped — defaults to preservation.
